meaning: The strange tangibility of old bookstores, which are filled with the scents of aged paper, worn bindings, and quiet histories.

sentence2: He spent hours breathing in the vellichor of the forgotten library. (He spent hours breathing in the vellichor of the forgotten library.)

meaning: A quiet, profound sense of inner dignity and emotional mastery during unexpected turmoil.
sentence1: A pesar de la tormenta, mantuvo un señorío admirable. (Despite the storm, he maintained an admirable dignity.)
sentence2: Su mirada reflejaba un señorío sereno y profundo. (His gaze reflected a serene and profound composure.)

meaning: A gentle flutter of emotional agitation or sudden sentimental awakening.
sentence1: Un doux émoi s'empara de son cœur en lisant la lettre. (A sweet flutter took hold of her heart upon reading the letter.)
sentence2: Il tenta de dissimuler son émoi devant elle. (He tried to hide his emotional stirring in front of her.)

meaning: Filled with a bittersweet, aching yearning for a distant time, place, or person.
sentence1: Sie blickte sehnsuchtsvoll in den abendlichen Himmel. (She looked longingly into the evening sky.)
sentence2: Ein sehnsuchtsvoll Lied erfüllte den Raum. (A wistfully yearning song filled the room.)

meaning: An awareness of the universe that triggers emotional responses too deep and mysterious for words.
sentence1: Kiri no naka de fukai yugen o kanjita. (I felt a deep sense of mysterious grace amidst the fog.)
sentence2: Sono keshiki wa yugen ni michite ita. (That scenery was filled with profound, ineffable beauty.)

meaning: A sudden, breathless leap of the heart caused by an unexpected wave of tenderness or surprise.
sentence1: Un piccolo sussulto le attraversò il petto quando lo vide. (A small leap crossed her chest when she saw him.)
sentence2: La notizia provocò un sussulto di gioia in tutta la stanza. (The news provoked a surge of joy across the whole room.)

meaning: A poignant emotional resonance felt when witnessing something fragile yet enduring.
sentence1: Ta de gushi rang ren gan dao chuangran. (His story made people feel a poignant melancholy.)
sentence2: Zhe fu hua dai you yizhong chuangran de mei. (This painting carries a kind of emotionally touching beauty.)

meaning: To feel an anxious, burning heartache out of deep care or suspense for someone.
sentence1: Geuui sosige maeumi aetatasda. (My heart burned with anxious longing over his news.)
sentence2: Aetatan simjeongeuro bameul jisewossda. (I spent the night awake with a heart full of anxious ache.)

meaning: A profound, tender weight of nostalgia and gentle worry held within the memory of loved ones.
sentence1: Knhom mean aroml mean annal jamneou mnusseh del jol chet. (I have a feeling of tender care and memory for those I love.)
sentence2: Chet knhom teaktoah knong kar smarah annal noh. (My heart softened within that quiet wave of sentimental recollection.)

meaning: An intense, soulful longing or yearning that resonates deeply within one's spirit.
sentence1: Sy het 'n sielsbegeerte na die stil natuur gehad. (She had a soulful yearning for the quiet nature.)
sentence2: Die musiek het sy diepste sielsbegeerte wakker gemaak. (The music awakened his deepest soulful longing.)
